required_nodes.rationale: The actual daemon composition helper loads fixed protocol custody, shares the resident objects, consumes immutable requests one stage at a time, preserves quiescence, and resumes without inference.
The daemon accepts only immutable fixed installation protocol custody with exact ID and digest equality.
The run-loop boundary loads explicit live configuration, invokes composition, injects the runtime, and preserves cognition-before-transition ordering.
A process restart cannot reconstruct an old process-local live quiescence token.
